npcAttitude.title: NPC Attitude and Emotion
npcAttitude.hint: Positive attitude and discontent are independent and can coexist. Unchecked Positive hides the green marker; None hides the emotion bar. Notes only: no changes to leader type, bonuses or rules.
npcAttitude.editHint: Click to set positive attitude and discontent separately (Uneasy 1 / Discontent 2 / Angry 3). GM only.
npcAttitude.readHint: Positive attitude and discontent are independent and can coexist. Uneasy 1 / Discontent 2 / Angry 3; GM editing only.
npcAttitude.stale: The office or permissions changed. Attitude was not saved; reopen the control.
npcAttitude.error: Failed to save NPC attitude. Check the console for details.
